newsitem.title: GERMANY: Japan agrees with US, Germany on forex, budget.
newsitem.headline: Japan agrees with US, Germany on forex, budget.

text.p: A Japanese financial official said on Saturday Japan was in agreement with Germany and the United States on the issues of foreign currencies and budget reform.
The official made the comments after Japanese Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka held talks with both U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin and his German counterpart Theo Waigel.
Asked whether the U.S. and Japan held the same position on currencies, the official said: "It is not that we are in discord on foreign exchange markets."
He added that Japan and Germany also shared the same position towards the foreign exchange market and on the need for budget consolidation in the group of seven most industrialised nations.
